title: Sunday · the morning after
logline: The Grunion beach the morning after the run: burned-out lanterns, a bucket left, fish scales in the sand catching the light. Nobody.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the beach at dawn after the run. Lantern stakes in the sand, a bucket on its side, footprints everywhere going nowhere.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a beach at dawn strewn with lantern stakes and a tipped bucket and thousands of footprints, no people, no words

panels.name: After

panels.composition: Tier 2: fish scales in the wet sand, catching the low sun like a spill of coins.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, close on wet sand scattered with silver fish scales catching low sunlight, no words

panels.name: Scales

panels.composition: Tier 3: the tide coming back up the beach over all of it. Held.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a tide edge sliding up a littered beach at dawn, no words

panels.name: Tide

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The run, the morning after. The scales like coins.
